gloss: after the fact; ex post facto; post-

definitions.gloss: after the fact; after the event; post-
definitions.explanation: Referring to actions, measures, or reports that come after a main event or situation has occurred.

examples.japanese: {事後|じご}{報告|ほうこく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{構|かま}いません。
examples.english: A report after the fact is also acceptable.

examples.japanese: {事後|じご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: We obtained approval after the fact.

examples.japanese: {事後|じご}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遅|おそ}すぎる。
examples.english: Responding after the fact is too late.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{事|じ} (matter, event) + ⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (after)
Literally: "after the matter" → "after the fact"

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can function as:
- Adverb: {事後|じご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜 (after the fact ~)
- Noun modifier: {事後|じご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (post- ~, ex post facto ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事後|じご}{報告|ほうこく} - post-event report
- {事後|じご}{承認|しょうにん} - retroactive approval
- {事後|じご}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ - post-incident response
- {事後|じご}{処理|しょり} - post-processing, aftermath handling
- {事後|じご}⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧ - post-evaluation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧ - beforehand, in advance

LEGAL TERM:
{事後法|じごほう} - ex post facto law (retroactive law)
